name: Libra of the Vampire Princess: Lycoris & Aoi in "The Promise" PLUS Iris in "Homeworld"
source:
"The Promise"

Lycoris wasn’t always a dim-witted, scythe-swinging servant of darkness; she was a well-known agent in the Rubina: a holy organization of skilled monster fighters and vampire slayers. In this scenario, we go back in time and explore the circumstances of how she and Aoi came to be formally paired together as “buddies” in the Rubina. On a deeper level, we hone in on a particularly gruesome event that would come to shape their eternal love and respect for one another—a bond which can never be broken.

"Homeworld"

Dernière, one of the many worlds that exist in different dimensions. As holders of a special power known as "life force", Dernièreans were blessed with vast energy and extended lifespans, and they lived in glorious prosperity. However, even for them the day of ruin approaches.

Taking place thousands of years before the events chronicled in Libra of the Vampire Princess, catch a glimpse of Dernière’s tragic history and the lives of those caught in the middle. You will meet Aconite Embroche, the determined leader of the Bebel’s sixth commando unit, and his smitten lieutenant, Iris Pumila. Together with Galega Officinalis, a lecherous and gifted dollmaker, they will use their superhuman powers to combat the infected life force from spreading and consuming their homeworld.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/644680/Libra_of_the_Vampire_Princess_Lycoris__Aoi_in_The_Promise_PLUS_Iris_in_Homeworld/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《承诺》莱科里斯并不总是一个愚蠢、挥舞着镰刀的黑暗仆人；她是鲁比纳的一位著名特工：一个由熟练的怪物战士和吸血鬼杀手组成的神圣组织。在这个场景中，我们回到过去，探索她和葵如何在鲁比纳正式结为“好友”的情况。在更深层次上，我们聚焦于一件特别可怕的事件，它将塑造他们对彼此永恒的爱和尊重——一种永远无法打破的纽带。

《家园》

Dernière，存在于不同维度的众多世界之一。作为被称为“生命力”的特殊力量的持有者，代尼埃人拥有巨大的能量和延长的寿命，他们生活在辉煌的繁荣之中。然而，即使对他们来说，毁灭的日子也即将来临。

故事发生在《吸血鬼公主的天秤座》中记载的事件发生数千年前，一睹德尔尼埃的悲惨历史以及夹在中间的人们的生活。你将见到倍倍尔第六突击队的坚定领袖阿康尼特·恩布罗什 (Aconite Embroche) 和他的迷恋中尉艾里斯·普米拉 (Iris Pumila)。他们将与好色且有天赋的玩偶制造者Galega Officinalis一起，利用超人的力量来对抗受感染的生命力，阻止其传播和吞噬他们的家园。

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/644680/Libra_of_the_Vampire_Princess_Lycoris__Aoi_in_The_Promise_PLUS_Iris_in_Homeworld/]Steam[/url]]
